claims.exactWording: Choose how Blanc blocks ads and trackers.
Customizable filter lists, advanced settings and a request logger for regular tabs.
Private tabs use Blanc Blocker. Changing blockers requires a restart. Site settings stay separate.

Blanc does not support installing arbitrary browser extensions. The bundled uBlock Origin provider is an optional blocking integration for regular tabs on supported builds, not general Chrome Web Store support. Private tabs use Blanc Blocker.
